notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental columns = Total Governmental Funds column (after its Adjustments column, which eliminates 102,507 of transfers hidden inside General Fund spending: Regular Instruction 52,507 to Employee Benefit; O&M 10,000 and Pupil Transportation 40,000 to Depreciation). Top-level transfers_out 65,000 = General Fund to School Nutrition; transfers in nil after elimination. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance 2,650,901 (p11); ending cash = total governmental funds assets 2,698,593 (p7), all cash and county treasurer cash. Roll-forward: 2,650,901 + 6,706,313 - 6,593,621 - 65,000 = 2,698,593. Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (p13): beginning 35,046 + receipts 217,670 + transfer 65,000 - disbursements 286,101 = 31,615. Statement of Activities p4 has handwritten corrections (281,101 to 286,101; total 6,874,722 to 6,879,722); the fund statement p13 prints 286,101, used. Other Support Services 233,808 (p11) split by fund column: Activities Fund 136,070 as student activities, Depreciation/Employee Benefit/Student Fee as support services. Receipts 'Other' 173,681 split using fund schedules (Activities 155,951 + Student Fee 5,300 + General Fund other lines 12,430). Attempt 2 (targeted re-check): 'Other State Receipts' 619,703 (p9; General 615,625 + Special Building 3,741 + QCPU 337) split using the fund budget schedules into Homestead Exemption 30,879, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 9,189 and remaining state aid 579,635; 'Grants from Corporations' 7,695 spending is category Categorical Corporation and Private; balance sheet governmental lines now from the governmental funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Fund Balances (pp7-8, Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification: restricted 169,334, committed 195,945 + 173,779 + 155,456, unassigned 2,004,079 = 2,698,593), whose totals equal the government-wide Statement of Net Position governmental column (p2, 2,698,593); business-type lines and totals from the Statement of Net Position (p2). Detail: General Fund budget schedule gives disbursements by function only (budget printed for total only); General Fund lines adjusted for hidden transfers per p9/p11 (three contra other financing lines), so detail items + other financing tie to printed 6,090,815. Activities Fund per-account schedule (p24-25) used instead of the one-line budget schedule (p21); zero-only accounts omitted; inter-account transfers net to 0 and are omitted. Student Fee, QCPU, Depreciation, EB, Special Building schedules recorded as printed; single-line expenditure schedules have no printed total. Read pages 1-25 of 25
